title: Monthly Community Working Group Meetings
author: emu-gov
body:
The Rev 5 & 20x Community Working Group Meetings are shifting from biweekly to monthly. Zoom meeting links will remain the same and times will be updated NLT next week.
* 23 July - next 20x meeting (monthly on 4th Wednesday)
* 6 Aug - next Rev 5 meeting (monthly on 1st Wednesday)

With the uptick in 20x pilot submissions and SCN beta testing beginning, this change will allow the FedRAMP PMO to focus on quality over quantity 💎
